premise: The local List<Task> really is copied before one Task.WhenAll. This is not a nonexistent-copy or necessary-array finding.
locatedSourceProducer: TransportManager.StopAsync and StopEndpointsAsync select transports, unbind listeners and await accept loops.
StopTransportConnection requests graceful close first; only its unsuccessful result invokes AbortAllConnectionsAsync.
AbortAllConnectionsAsync resolves live weak references, sets the existing end reason, aborts the real transport and collects each connection.ExecutionTask in a local List<Task>.
ExecutionTask is the base connection completion-TCS task. The actual connection delegate/finally path disposes the transport then removes it; global ConnectionManager.RemoveConnection calls Complete.
The source includes endpoint stop/reconfiguration as well as server stop; it is not a per-request path or a server-stop-only claim.
